fusions.name: Bank Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges from stillness with the shield's edge and holds the target under it, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and stunning it for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Holds still behind the shield for 1.5 seconds, then clamps it shut and rolls, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Against a boss or elite it adds 6% of the target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Lure and Hide
fusions.desc: Lies still behind the shield: up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds, and the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Jaw
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
